title: 第17章 人类第18章 人类2
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
哥布林大军出征，李秦武让部队沿着大河往西边走。
一路上除了赶路就是赶路，每天赶路16个小时。
李秦武也怕哥布林们受不了，可他想试试哥布林的体力上限，然后他有些惊住了，只要提供足够的水和食物，他们就能一直走走走。
李秦武开发出个行军小技巧，哥布林们走到士气低下，直接发肉干，每人一条，都不用停下，他们就可以乐呵呵的继续行军。
这么搞的后果是食物消耗很大，一只哥布林每天都要吃六块肉干。
好在李秦武这一个月来猎杀了超多的角鳄，只要他们能加快行军速度，肉干随便他们吃。
在充足食物的补充下，根本没用4天，第3天哥布林军队们就抵达了人类村庄附近。
这天中午左右，李秦武带着部队在河岸边行军，突然，他伸手成拳让行军部队停下。
李秦武耸动着鼻子，闻着风中传来的味道。
“烟火味！”
偌大的魔法森林，会生火的魔物可不多，李秦武知道自己到了。
“全军！进入森林驻扎，吃饭，然后给我睡觉，不准说话，不准随便走动，违者杀！”
李秦武让部队躲到森林里去，可别被人类瞅见了，不然就失了先机。
他把大哥布林分成两组，哥布大带一组，让他盯着填线宝宝们，自己带另一组往人类部落摸过去，他要探探点。
“弓弩上弦，给我把耳朵竖起来，眼睛睁大咯，看见异常立马喊我！”
李秦武带着人往前面摸，大哥布林们都紧紧跟着他，不一会儿，李秦武闻到的烟火味更多了，地上也有大量人类活动的痕迹。
骑砍2有个侦查技能，李秦武能从地上的痕迹看到各种信息。
眼前的痕迹很多，很杂，但是侦查技能把信息都标注出来了。
痕迹1：人数3，时间3天前。
痕迹2：人数5，时间2天前。

痕迹3：人数4，时间1天前。
留下这些痕迹的人数量不多，李秦武分享可能是人类的狩猎部队，这里就是人类的主要活动区了。
“都小心点，这里可能遇到敌人。”
李秦武吩咐了一句，带着部队继续往前走，走着走着，李秦武又让人停下了，侦查技能显示前面的草叶里有危险。
李秦武用木矛扫掉前面的枯枝烂叶，露出一个捕兽夹。
李秦武捡了块石头，往捕兽夹一砸，咔嚓一声，捕兽夹狠狠合拢。
李秦武把捕兽夹拿起，递给身后的哥布矛，让他拿着，这可是难得的铁器。
众人继续前进，又薅了4个捕兽夹，而且还遇到其他陷阱，都被李秦武用侦查技能排除了。
他们从大部队驻扎的地方摸索前进了3公里，森林开始稀疏，李秦武看到了人类的驻扎地，然后直接懵逼住了。
“草！这我怎么玩！”
他们确实找到了人类村庄，可踏马的人家村庄有城墙啊！
只见森林外一块土地被开垦出来，一些人类农夫在土地上耕种，土地后面是木墙，差不多3米高，后面的情况看不清，但无非是住房。
content_en:
The goblin army went out for battle, and Li Qinwu asked the troops to go west along the river.
Along the way, there was nothing but rushing, 16 hours a day.
Li Qinwu was also afraid that the goblins wouldn't be able to bear it, but he wanted to test the upper limit of the goblins' physical strength. Then he was a little shocked. As long as they provided enough water and food, they could keep walking.
Li Qinwu developed a little marching technique. When the goblins reached a point where their morale was low, they would directly hand out dried meat, one to each of them, without stopping, and they could happily continue marching.
The consequence of this is that it consumes a lot of food. A goblin eats six pieces of dried meat every day.
Fortunately, Li Qinwu had hunted a lot of horned crocodiles in the past month. As long as they could speed up their march, they could eat the dried meat as long as they wanted.
With sufficient food, it didn't take four days at all. On the third day, the goblin army arrived near the human village.
Around noon that day, Li Qinwu led his troops to march along the river bank. Suddenly, he stretched out his hand into a fist to stop the marching troops.
Li Qinwu twitched his nose and smelled the smell in the wind.
"The smell of fireworks!"
In the huge magical forest, there weren't many monsters that could make fire. Li Qinwu knew he had arrived.
"All the troops! Enter the forest to station, eat, and then let me sleep. You are not allowed to talk or move around casually. Anyone who violates this will be killed!"
Li Qinwu asked the troops to hide in the forest to avoid being seen by humans, otherwise they would lose the opportunity.
He divided the big goblins into two groups. The big goblin led one group and asked him to keep an eye on the line-filling babies. He led the other group to explore the human tribe. He wanted to explore the spots.
"String the crossbow, prick up your ears and open your eyes. If you see anything unusual, call me immediately!"
Li Qinwu led the people to the front, and the big brothers and brothers followed him closely. After a while, Li Qinwu smelled more fireworks, and there were a lot of traces of human activities on the ground.
Cavalry Blade 2 has a reconnaissance skill. Li Qinwu can see various information from the traces on the ground.
There were many traces in front of me and they were very complicated, but my investigative skills marked all the information.
Trace 1: Number of people 3, time 3 days ago.
Trace 2: Number of people 5, time 2 days ago.
Trace 3: Number of people 4, time 1 day ago.
There are not many people who left these traces. Li Qinwu shared that they may be human hunting troops, and this is the main activity area of ​​humans.
"Be careful, you may encounter enemies here."
Li Qinwu gave the order and continued to move forward with his troops. As they walked, Li Qinwu made people stop again. His detection skills showed that there was danger in the grass blades in front.
Li Qinwu used a wooden spear to sweep away the dead branches and leaves in front of him, revealing a animal trap.
Li Qinwu picked up a stone and threw it at the animal trap. With a click, the animal trap closed tightly.
Li Qinwu picked up the animal trap and handed the Gob spear behind him to hold it. This was a rare iron weapon.
Everyone continued to move forward and collected four more animal traps. They also encountered other traps, but Li Qinwu used his investigative skills to eliminate them.
They groped forward for 3 kilometers from where the large army was stationed, and the forest began to sparse. Li Qinwu saw the human station, and was immediately confused.
"Fuck! How can I play with this!"
They did find a human village, but the horse-riding village had walls!
I saw a piece of land outside the forest being reclaimed, and some human farmers were cultivating the land. Behind the land was a wooden wall, almost 3 meters high. The situation behind it could not be seen clearly, but it was nothing more than housing.
